name: fl
description: Forgeloom workflow commands: /fl:define (charter, spec, or shared spec across repos), /fl:fix (bug with root cause and regression test), /fl:promote (promote a lesson to knowledge/<stack>/patterns/) and /fl:import (split an existing all-in-one spec into a multi-repo project without losing any text; detects the technologies, creates one git-flow repo per technology), plus a checker for import-ready source specs.
